Done. Created one new file, `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` — no other files touched.

## Approach

- **Style match**: Sibling tests (`StopWatchTest`, `DateFormatUtilsTest`, etc.) are JUnit 3.8 — `extends TestCase`, `junit.framework.*`, `String`-arg constructor, `suite()`, `assertEquals/assertTrue/assertFalse/fail` + try/catch for expected exceptions. This test follows that exactly (it still runs fine under the `org.junit.runner.JUnitCore` command via the JUnit 3 adapter).
- **Determinism**: every expected value and every input `Date`/`Calendar` is built through the same helper (`Calendar` in the JVM default zone), so results stay internally consistent regardless of the runner's timezone. Chosen wall-clock times avoid DST spring-forward gaps. Verified green across 18 timezone × locale combinations (São Paulo/Sydney/Kolkata/Kiritimati/New York/Paris × en_US/fr_FR/th_TH).

## Coverage (48 test methods)

| Area | What's asserted |
|---|---|
| constructor / constants | single public ctor, non-final class; `UTC_TIME_ZONE` id/offset, `MILLIS_PER_*`, `SEMI_MONTH`, `RANGE_*` values |
| `isSameDay` / `isSameInstant` / `isSameLocalTime` | true/false on same-day-diff-time, diff day/month/year, same-instant-diff-zone, single differing field, different `Calendar` subclass; `IllegalArgumentException` on each null position; arguments not mutated |
| `parseDate` | field-level result, later-pattern-in-list wins; `ParseException` on no match / trailing text / empty pattern array; `IllegalArgumentException` on null str or null patterns |
| `add` + 8 `addXxx` | positive/negative/zero amounts with month/year/day rollover, `addMilliseconds` checked against raw millis, input `Date` unchanged, returned object is new; `IllegalArgumentException` on null date for all 9 |
| `truncate` (Date/Calendar/Object) | every supported field incl. `HOUR_OF_DAY`, `AM_PM` (→ midnight/noon), `SEMI_MONTH` (→ 1st/16th); `MILLISECOND` is a no-op; idempotent; input not mutated; returned `Calendar` is a distinct object |
| `round` (Date/Calendar/Object) | round-down vs round-up boundary at exactly 30 min, DATE/MONTH/YEAR/`SEMI_MONTH` rounding both directions; input not mutated |
| round/truncate errors | null for all three overloads each; wrong `Object` type → `ClassCastException`; unsupported field (`DAY_OF_WEEK`) → `IllegalArgumentException` (and caller's `Date` untouched); year > 280M → `ArithmeticException` |
| `iterator` | all 6 range styles with asserted first day, exact day count (7 / 35), last day; strictly-advancing days; `Date` and `Object` overloads; focus `Calendar` not mutated; consecutive elements are distinct clones one day apart; exhausted iterator → `NoSuchElementException`; `remove()` → `UnsupportedOperationException`; null focus (3 overloads); invalid range style (`-1`, `100`); wrong `Object` type → `ClassCastException` |
